title: Homework set: graph shapes and transformations
subject: Mathematics
unit: Spring 1: Revision cycle 1: Number, algebra, sequences, graphs
source: Written for mathematics/y11 lesson 66 (Complete the portal's graphs and transformations set (6 questions) and update your repair list.)
intro: 6 questions. f(x) = x². Show your working. Mark it with the mark scheme and add any errors to your repair list.

questions.q: Describe the transformation that maps y = f(x) onto y = f(x) − 5, and give the new turning point.
questions.a: Translation down 5, by vector (0, −5); turning point (0, −5) (B1)

questions.q: Describe the transformation that maps y = f(x) onto y = f(x + 2), and give the new turning point.
questions.a: Translation 2 to the left, by vector (−2, 0) (B1); turning point (−2, 0) (B1)

questions.q: Describe the transformation that maps y = f(x) onto y = −f(x).
The point (3, 7) lies on the curve y = g(x). Write down the point it moves to on y = g(x − 4) + 1.
The maximum of y = sin x for 0° ≤ x ≤ 360° is at (90°, 1). Write down the maximum point of (a) y = sin x + 2 (b) y = sin(x + 30°).
Describe the shape of each graph: (a) y = x³ (b) y = 1/x (c) y = 2ˣ (d) y = −x².
questions.a: (a) cubic: an S-shape through the origin (b) reciprocal: two branches, the axes are asymptotes (c) exponential: through (0, 1), always positive, increasing (d) an upside-down parabola with its maximum at (0, 0) (B1 each)
